instruction.text: Desna erzählt von ihren Ferien. Lies dir den Text durch und beantworte die Fragen.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>sightseeing</voice> bedeutet auf Deutsch Besichtigung von Sehenswürdigkeiten.

atoms.text: In the summer holidays, I will go camping with my dad. In the Easter holidays, I went to London with my mum and my older brother Jaspal. We spent three days in London and went sightseeing. On our first day we saw Big Ben, Tower Bridge and Trafalgar Square.

atoms.a: Where did she spend the Easter holidays?
Who went to London with her?
How long did they stay there?
Which sights did they see on their first day?
b: ++Big Ben, Tower Bridge and Trafalgar Square
Tate Modern, the Emirates Stadium and the London Eye
Buckingham Palace and the Sherlock Holmes Museum

instruction.text: Desna erzählt von ihren Ferien. Lies dir den Text durch und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: On our second day we visited Tate Modern. We also visited Covent Garden, because my brother loves to go shopping. We wanted to see the London Eye that day, but we didn't have enough time. On our last day, we visited Buckingham Palace, because my mum is a fan of the Royal Family. We went to the Sherlock Holmes Museum, because I love the Sherlock Holmes books. All in all, we saw a lot of sights and had lots of fun.

atoms.a: Why did they visit Buckingham Palace?
b: Desna's brother is a fan of the Royal Family.
++Desna's mum is a fan of the Royal Family.
Desna is a fan of the Royal Family.

atoms.a: Which museums and galleries did they visit in London?

atoms.a: Which sight didn't they visit on their second day?
Why didn't they visit the London Eye?
b: Desna's brother didn't want to see the London Eye.
They already saw the London Eye the last time.
